versions.changelog:
- Initial release of HTML Deck Builder.
- Converts a topic or Markdown outline into a standalone, paginated HTML slide deck with keyboard navigation, progress bar, and page numbers.
- No dependencies or internet required; open directly in browser for full-screen presentation.
- Supports light and dark themes, accepts outlines with `#` (cover/end), `##` (section), and `###` (content) headings.
- Designed for quick, no-hassle PPT-style slides from minimal input.
